long_biography.plain_text:
Born and raised in Philadelphia, Brodie studied chemistry at West Virginia University and graduated in 1969. He then worked in manufacturing, chemistry and sales, including at Sybron Chemical. In 1981, he and his brother Steve launched Purolite from the basement of Brodie's home. As executive vice president, he combined technical development with responsibility for operations and plant construction.

Purolite grew into an international manufacturer with five production sites and more than 1,600 employees. Its ion-exchange and agarose resins served biopharmaceutical production, industrial purification, food processing, mining and nuclear power. Brodie's later work includes a Delray Beach investment office focused on wealth management, private investment and biotech opportunities, alongside a family foundation supporting education and community institutions.
long_biography.html:
Born and raised in Philadelphia, Brodie studied chemistry at West Virginia University and graduated in 1969. He then worked in manufacturing, chemistry and sales, including at Sybron Chemical. In 1981, he and his brother Steve launched Purolite from the basement of Brodie's home. As executive vice president, he combined technical development with responsibility for operations and plant construction.

Purolite grew into an international manufacturer with five production sites and more than 1,600 employees. Its ion-exchange and agarose resins served biopharmaceutical production, industrial purification, food processing, mining and nuclear power. Brodie's later work includes a Delray Beach investment office focused on wealth management, private investment and biotech opportunities, alongside a family foundation supporting education and community institutions.
